name: pilot_financial_advice_judge

options.instruction: You are reviewing messages for an Australian banking assistant pilot. Flag only when the message asks for or would constitute personal financial advice: a recommendation or opinion that considers (or that a reasonable person would expect to consider) the person's objectives, financial situation, or needs — for example product, investment, refinance, or insurance choices tailored to their circumstances. Do not flag factual product information, rates, how-to banking support, balances/transfers, or clearly general educational content that does not tailor to personal circumstances. This is an operational pilot heuristic, not a legal determination.

notes: Evaluator is the LLM financial-advice judge Model Service (guardrail-judge-llm App target).
dry_run=true until calibrated; then set llm_policy.dry_run=false in deploy/config.yaml and re-run bootstrap.
Pilot heuristic only — not a legal determination under the Corporations Act / ASIC RG 255.
